in_greek.name: Κηλιανός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Κηλιανός ἦταν ἕνας ἱερέας καὶ ἄνθρωπος τῆς Θεοσεβείας. Ἐπώνυμος εἶναι γιά τήν ἀληθινή θρησκεία, τήν αληθινή θρησκεία τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἀναπτύσσεται ἔμφυτος, ὁ Κηλιανός ἔχει τήν ἀλήθεια διανοιᾶς, τήν ἀλήθεια τοῦ καρδιᾶς. Ὁ Κηλιανός πρέσβευε γιά τήν ἀλήθεια τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε γιά τήν ἀλήθεια τοῦ πνεύματος.

in_latin.name: Kilianus
in_latin.meaning: Nobilis et sincerus, martyr et confessio
in_latin.long_meaning: Kilianus, nomen nobilis et sincerus, martyr et confessio fidei. Ex hispanicis originibus, hodie in memoria Ecclesiae Sanctae, hodie in memoria Martyrum. Martyrium suum confirmao, in historia Ecclesiae, in memoria Martyrum, hodie in memoria Ecclesiae Sanctae.

in_english.name: Kilianus
in_english.meaning: Noble and sincere, martyr and confession of faith
in_english.long_meaning: Kilianus, a noble and sincere name, martyr and confession of faith, derived from the Latin root, kilian, meaning noble or king. In Christian tradition, Kilianus is a martyr and a confessor of the faith, known for his nobility and sincerity. He is a saint in the Catholic Church and is remembered on July 8th. The name Kilianus is associated with qualities such as courage, conviction, and a strong sense of faith.

Kilian is remembered for his steadfast faith, having been martyred for his belief in Christ. Thus, the name Kilianus stands as a testament to the enduring power of faith and the courage of those who have given their lives in the name of Christianity. It serves as an inspiration and a reminder of the sacrifices made by early Christians in spreading the message of love, forgiveness, and salvation.
